arguments.query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, is_credit, eur_amount, aci, issuing_country, acquirer_country, has_fraudulent_dispute,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS mth
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store' AND year = 2023
),
mon AS (
  SELECT mth, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
    SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fraud_ratio
  FROM base GROUP BY mth
),
tx AS (
  SELECT b.psp_reference, b.is_credit, b.eur_amount, b.aci, b.issuing_country, b.acquirer_country,
    CASE WHEN m.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN m.vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN m.vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_b,
    CASE WHEN m.fraud_ratio < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN m.fraud_ratio < 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN m.fraud_ratio <= 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_b
  FROM base b JOIN mon m USING (mth)
),
schemes AS (SELECT s FROM UNNEST(['GlobalCard','NexPay','SwiftCharge','TransactPlus']) AS s),
cand AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, sc.s AS card_scheme, f.ID,
    f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM tx t
  CROSS JOIN schemes sc
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f ON f.card_scheme = sc.s
  WHERE (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type), 0) = 0 OR 'R' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
    AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
    AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code), 0) = 0 OR 5942 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
    AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
    AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci), 0) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
    AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = IF(t.issuing_country = t.acquirer_country, 1, 0))
    AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = t.vol_b)
    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = t.fraud_b)
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, COUNT(*) AS n_match,
    ARRAY_AGG(fee ORDER BY ID LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS fee
  FROM cand GROUP BY psp_reference, card_scheme
)
SELECT card_scheme,
  COUNT(*) AS tx_matched,
  COUNTIF(n_match > 1) AS ambiguous_tx,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx) - COUNT(*) AS tx_unmatched,
  ROUND(SUM(fee), 2) AS total_fee_eur
FROM per_tx
GROUP BY card_scheme
ORDER BY total_fee_eur

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS tid, eur_amount, is_credit, aci,
    (issuing_country = acquirer_country) AS intra,
    has_fraudulent_dispute,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2022-12-31', INTERVAL day_of_year DAY)) AS mo
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store' AND year = 2023
),
m AS (
  SELECT mo, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fr
  FROM tx GROUP BY mo
),
t2 AS (
  SELECT t.tid, t.eur_amount, t.is_credit, t.aci, t.intra,
    CASE WHEN m.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN m.vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN m.vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vb,
    CASE WHEN m.fr < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN m.fr <= 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN m.fr <= 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fb
  FROM tx t JOIN m USING (mo)
),
s AS (SELECT DISTINCT card_scheme FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`),
cand AS (
  SELECT t2.tid, s.card_scheme, f.ID, f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t2.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM t2 CROSS JOIN s
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f ON f.card_scheme = s.card_scheme
  WHERE (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type), 0) = 0 OR 'R' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
    AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code), 0) = 0 OR 5942 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
    AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t2.is_credit)
    AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci), 0) = 0 OR t2.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
    AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = CAST(t2.intra AS INT64))
    AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
    AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = t2.vb)
    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = t2.fb)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.tid, c.card_scheme) AS n_rules,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.tid, c.card_scheme ORDER BY c.ID) AS rn
  FROM cand c
)
SELECT card_scheme,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tid) AS tx_matched,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2) AS total_tx,
  COUNTIF(rn = 1 AND n_rules > 1) AS tx_with_multiple_rules,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(rn = 1, fee, 0)), 4) AS fee_first_rule,
  ROUND(SUM(fee) / COUNT(DISTINCT tid), 4) AS avg_fee_all_rules_per_tx
FROM ranked
GROUP BY card_scheme
ORDER BY fee_first_rule

grid AS (

),

  SELECT g.rn, g.scheme, g.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate

    (issuing_country = acquirer_country) AS is_intra,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS m
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store' AND year = 2023
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT m, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
    100 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_fraud THEN eur_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fraud_pct
  FROM (SELECT *, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS m,
          has_fraudulent_dispute AS has_fraud
        FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
        WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store' AND year = 2023)
  GROUP BY m
),
mb AS (
  SELECT m, vol, fraud_pct,
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_b,
    CASE WHEN fraud_pct < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fraud_pct <= 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN fraud_pct <= 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraud_b

   AND (f.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR 5942 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.eur_amount, p.is_credit, p.aci, p.has_fraudulent_dispute,
    IF(p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intra,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2023-01-01', INTERVAL p.day_of_year - 1 DAY)) AS mo
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store' AND p.year = 2023
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT mo, SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) AS fraud_vol
  FROM base GROUP BY mo
),
txn AS (
  SELECT b.psp_reference, b.eur_amount, b.is_credit, b.aci, b.intra,
    CASE WHEN m.vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN m.vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN m.vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vol_band,
    CASE WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.fraud_vol, m.vol) < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%'
         WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.fraud_vol, m.vol) <= 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.fraud_vol, m.vol) <= 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%'
         ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fr_band
  FROM base b JOIN monthly m USING (mo)
),
schemes AS (
  SELECT s AS scheme FROM UNNEST(['GlobalCard','NexPay','SwiftCharge','TransactPlus']) AS s
),
priced AS (
  SELECT sc.scheme, t.psp_reference, f.ID AS rule_id,
    f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM txn t
  CROSS JOIN schemes sc
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = sc.scheme
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'R' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR 5942 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = t.intra)

)
